filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Combine search, folders, and favorites to find your images.
filters.ratioHint: Ratios allow ±2% tolerance. Images with unknown dimensions are excluded from orientation, ratio, and dimension filters.
filters.invalidPixels: Dimensions must be whole pixels between 1 and 4,294,967,295. Leave a field empty for no limit.
filters.invalidSize: File size must be a non-negative number in MB. Leave a field empty for no limit.
filters.invalidRange: The minimum {{field}} cannot exceed the maximum.
filters.invalidRatio: Enter a positive ratio such as 16:9 or 2.35:1.
filters.excludeNamesHint: Hide images whose file names contain any keyword. Use one per line or separate with commas. Keywords are remembered in this browser.
filters.excludedNamesTooLong: Excluded keywords must total no more than 4,096 UTF-8 bytes.
filters.excludedNamesTooMany: Use no more than 50 excluded keywords.
filters.excludedNameTooLong: Each excluded keyword must contain no more than 100 characters.
filters.excludedNameInvalidCharacter: Excluded keywords cannot contain the null character (NUL). Remove that character.

auth.loginFailed: Unable to sign in. Please try again.
auth.footer: Your images. Ready when inspiration strikes.

display.title: Display settings
display.columnsHint: Narrow windows use fewer columns to keep thumbnails easy to see and select.
display.automaticHint: Adjust columns to the window width and grid density.

designs.title: Designs
designs.description: Create with your assets. Save layouts and keep refining them.
designs.emptyListHint: Create a design here, or connect ChatGPT to Picsoc to get started.
designs.newerRevision: A newer revision is available. Download your draft before loading the latest layout.
designs.invalidJson: The layout must be a valid JSON object. Check brackets, quotes, and commas.
designs.previewEmptyHint: Save a layout and render a preview, or open a design created with ChatGPT.
designs.previewLoadFailedHint: Check that the service is running, then try again.
designs.editorHint: Save after editing. Rendering a preview or PNG saves the current layout first.
designs.workflowHint: Layers are drawn in array order, from bottom to top. Use the asset ID shown in an asset preview for image layers. Add the example below to the layers array, replacing 1 with an actual asset ID.
designs.imageHint: x / y specify the top-left corner, width / height set the display size; contain shows the whole image, and opacity ranges from 0 to 1.
designs.noFonts: No fonts found. Add font files to the fonts folder in the data directory and restart the service.
designs.fontHint: Text layers choose a font using font_id. For Chinese text, choose a font marked with Chinese support.
designs.storageNote: Original assets remain read-only. Layouts and rendered images are saved in the Picsoc data directory.
designs.discardHint: Switching designs will discard your edits. Download a draft first, or cancel and save your layout.
